ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light-grey) central surface area occupying approximately 80-85% of pixels, contrasted against low-intensity (black) peripheral banding and concentrated mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black band along the trailing edge and lobe tips; localized low-intensity vertical streaks extending from the lower margin towards the center of both lobes; scattered low-intensity punctate spots throughout the high-intensity field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) continuous across the entire trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curves originating at the median notch, transitioning into broad convex arcs that terminate in sharp, slightly upward-curved distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of high-contrast white spots (likely barnacle scars) is concentrated on the extreme outer edge of the right fluke tip against the black border.
